item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Classic Fish Cakes – Traditional, golden-fried fish cakes served with potatoes, a coarse, cold remoulade and a fresh cabbage and dill salad. Served with warm rye bread on the side. (1+2+3+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Chili con Carne – A spicy, rich Mexican-inspired stew with minced beef, beans and corn, seasoned with cumin, garlic and a hint of dark chocolate. Served with fluffy rice and cool sour cream. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: sin Carne – A flavourful vegetarian version made with nourishing lentils, beans and corn, simmered in a deep, spiced tomato sauce. Served with fluffy rice and cool sour cream. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Fish’n’chips burger with salad and tartar sauce. (1+2+3+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Breaded and fried tofu burger with salad and tartar sauce. (1+2+7+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Chicken katsu curry – Japanese comfort with breaded chicken, rice and curry sauce. (1+8+13) GREEN DISH: Dish Tempura oyster mushrooms with rice and curry sauce. (1+8+13)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: A classic grilled wild-garlic sausage (pork) in a warm hot dog bun, topped with mustard, ketchup, remoulade, pickled cucumber and roasted and raw onions. An everyday favourite, served with a simple warm winter potato salad of cabbage, carrot and apple on the side. (1+2+11) GREEN DISH: Dish Vegan sausage in a warm hot dog bun, topped with mustard, ketchup, remoulade, pickled cucumber and roasted and raw onions. An everyday favourite, served with a simple warm winter potato salad of cabbage, carrot and apple on the side. (1+2+7+11)
